tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250yang gsang e ring rnal ma 'jam dpal zhi khro'i lha rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa'i drag sngags kyi rgyal po ni/1$0000300 oṃ ayai ayai ayai/ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ya ma ye/ kā la rū pa ka pa ye/ hrīḥṣṭi a pa ye/ a a ne a ne/ u u ne u ne/ du du ne du ne/ a i u e o aṃ/ ra rī la lī/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ sing ha ye/ hri da ye/ bhi ta ye/ tsitta ye/ ha la ye/ mu ka ye/ u u ne u u ne/ byi tri ta/ a a nan/ ya ma rā tsa/ ya ma raksha/ ya ma raka a/ ya ma rakṣa/ bai tā li kro tī shwa ri ma ma e ka tsā ti/ de ma kha la baṃ ril ru lu ru lu shrī badzra kro ta ya ma karma ro ṣa ṇa kro dha tsaṇḍa raksha mon ta/ āḥhūm̐ dzaḥ

ayai ring gi raksha monta'i mtshams su gzir ba g.yu spyang gi sham bu ni/ gnod byed a mu ka myags thums ril trig nan sbur ya nanaḥ e hur thums dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya/ zhes pa nyid do/ ༈ /zlog pa g.yu'i spyang mo ni/ rtsa ba monta'i mtshams su/ pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i byad kha rbod gtong sogs 'gal rkyen bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad e nan yaṃ zlog 'drid bhyoḥ e hur thums dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya/ zhes dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭi wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sha ri bhyo zlog /ma ri bhyo zlog /khrag ma ma bhyo zlog /tsi ri snying bhyo zlog /snying bhyo zlog /ma ti thod khrag dza bhyo zlog /khrag ti snying la ya bhyo zlog /ni tri chod zlog /nā ga chod zlog /mu lo chod zlog /sha lo chod zlog /sha la kying kying bhyo zlog /sa ma ya a ti pra ma na ya/ ni sā ra ni bhyo bhyo zlog zlog / 'char kha nag po'i sngags grong khyer bco lnga pa'o/ ༈ /stong tshigs kyi mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod// bag med nyams chag 'gal 'khrul bshags// mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol// ma hā a mṛta rakta ba lingta sarba pū dza khā hi/ zhes so// maṅga laṃ/// /
